address: 29 Cunzhong Street, West District, Taichung, 403, Taiwan
bio: No matter where you sit in this glass-clad space occupying two floors, a good view onto the lush Japanese garden is guaranteed. The Japanese chef team strives to recreate authentic Fukuoka flavours. The two set menus comprises of sashimi, hot dishes and dessert, with the niigata rice steamed in a rustic claypot with assorted seasonal ingredients being the highlight. Pre-order the itamae or chef's menu if you have a big appetite.
